sources.name: Cedar River Paddling Trips guide, published by Charles City Chamber of Commerce
observations: Names Idlewild Park Access, gives the address 1374 Quarry Road, Floyd, and publishes GPS 43.1633388,-92.75409209999998, matching the shared route coordinate.
Lists the downstream Rotary Park Access 5.6 miles away, matching the route chain.
sources.limits: The guide provides an access-area GPS coordinate but does not describe a ramp, landing toe, or the on-site carry.

sources.name: Floyd County / MyCountyParks West Idlewild Campground record
observations: Current county-managed park record locates West Idlewild at 1374 Quarry Road, two miles northwest of Floyd along the Cedar River.
Lists Canoe access among the facilities and identifies camping, fishing, and boating activities.
sources.limits: Confirms a public canoe-access site but does not give a separate waterline coordinate.

sources.name: Floyd County Conservation Cedar River Float listing
observations: County Conservation describes a Cedar River float ending at West Idlewild Park, 1374 Quarry Road, with vehicle shuttle support.
sources.limits: Corroborates route use at the public facility, not the exact landing point.

sources.name: Google Maps satellite imagery at stored point
observations: The coordinate falls by Quarry Road in the West Idlewild approach area on the Cedar River bank.
Heavy tree cover obscures the specific river carry and landing.
sources.limits: Visual check only; no coordinate was derived from the imagery.

decision: Retain the published matching access-area coordinate as an authoritative site anchor; do not claim it is a surveyed water-entry toe.
